messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: http://microfluidics.utoronto.ca/papers/estrogen%20and%20TSH%20immunoassay.pdf
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.1021/ac3020627

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Digital Microfluidic Magnetic Separation Particle-Based Immunoassay (TSH and 17β-estradiol)

REAGENTS USED:
  - Antibody-coated paramagnetic microparticles (suspended in DMF-compatible buffer)
  - Sample containing analyte (e.g., Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH) or 17β-estradiol (E2))
  - Wash buffer
  - Enzyme-conjugated reporter antibody (for TSH) or competitive tracer (for E2)
  - Chemiluminescent substrate

STEPS:
1. Particle and Sample Mixing: Dispense droplets of magnetic microparticles and sample. Merge and mix to allow antibody-antigen binding.
2. Magnetic Separation: Engage external magnet to immobilize magnetic particles, drawing off the supernatant.
3. First Wash: Dispense wash buffer, merge with particles, disengage magnet to resuspend, then re-engage magnet to separate and draw off supernatant. Repeat to ensure greater than 90% unbound reagent removal.
4. Reporter Binding: Dispense reporter antibody droplet, merge with particles, and mix.
5. Second Wash: Engage magnet, separate particles, and draw off supernatant. Wash again with buffer droplets.
6. Detection: Dispense chemiluminescent substrate, merge with the separated particles, and detect the signal.

INTERPRETATION: Target analyte concentration is proportional to the chemiluminescent signal for the noncompetitive TSH assay, and inversely proportional for the competitive 17β-estradiol assay.

ir.content:
main:
	particles1[0] = dispense(MagneticParticles)
	s11[0] = dispense(Sample)
	s21[0] = dispense(Sample)
	s31[0] = dispense(Sample)
	mix11[0] = mix(particles1[0], s11[0])
	mix21[0] = mix(mix11[0], s21[0])
	sample_complex1[0] = mix(mix21[0], s31[0])
	heat(sample_complex1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 360.0SECOND
bsbbr_2_h:
	PHI washed1 = {washed0,washed2}
	PHI wb1 = {wb0,wb2}
	PHI REPEAT_41 = {REPEAT_40,REPEAT_42}
	if REPEAT_41[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_3_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_4_f
bsbbr_3_t:
	wb2[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	washed2[0] = mix(sample_complex1[0], wb2[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	dispose(washed2[0])
	REPEAT_42[0] = REPEAT_41[0] - 1
bsbbr_4_f:
	conj1[0] = dispense(Conjugate)
	conjugate_complex1[0] = mix(sample_complex1[0], conj1[0])
	heat(conjugate_complex1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 120.0SECOND
bsbbr_5_h:
	PHI wb21 = {wb20,wb22}
	PHI washed21 = {washed20,washed22}
	PHI REPEAT_43 = {REPEAT_41,REPEAT_44}
	if REPEAT_43[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_6_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_7_f
bsbbr_6_t:
	wb22[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	washed22[0] = mix(conjugate_complex1[0], wb22[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	dispose(washed22[0])
	REPEAT_44[0] = REPEAT_43[0] - 1
bsbbr_7_f:
bsbbr_8_h:
	PHI REPEAT_21 = {REPEAT_20,REPEAT_22}
	PHI rinsed1 = {rinsed0,rinsed2}
	PHI rinse1 = {rinse0,rinse2}
	if REPEAT_21[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_9_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_10_f
bsbbr_9_t:
	rinse2[0] = dispense(H2O2)
	rinsed2[0] = mix(conjugate_complex1[0], rinse2[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	dispose(rinsed2[0])
	REPEAT_22[0] = REPEAT_21[0] - 1
bsbbr_10_f:
	peroxide1[0] = dispense(H2O2)
	substrate_complex1[0] = mix(conjugate_complex1[0], peroxide1[0])
	heat(substrate_complex1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 120.0SECOND
	luminol1[0] = dispense(LuminolEnhancer)
	signal_complex1[0] = mix(substrate_complex1[0], luminol1[0])
	heat(signal_complex1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 60.0SECOND
	assay_signal1[0] = detect(fluorescence, signal_complex1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	if assay_signal1[0] <= 0	|	true: jump bsbbif_11_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_12_f
bsbbif_11_t:
	dispose(signal_complex1[0])
bsbbif_12_f:
	PHI signal_complex2 = {signal_complex1,signal_complex}
	dispose(signal_complex2[0])
	NOP
